meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将脑影像数据整理为 BIDS 标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理神经科学影像数据并需要 BIDS 合规化
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroscience imaging data into BIDS standard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are processing neuroscience imaging data and need BIDS compliance

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按 BIDS 标准整理和查询脑成像等科研数据:建立目录结构、写 dataset_description.json、用 PyBIDS 查文件、校验合规性、把 DICOM 转成 BIDS、写 JSON 边车文件等。
howto.when: 当你处理 BIDS 数据集,如整理 MRI/EEG 等神经科学数据、查询 BIDS 布局、或校验合规性时触发。

say.text: 用 PyBIDS 查询这个数据集里所有被试的 T1w 文件
帮我把这个 DICOM 文件夹转成 BIDS 格式
say.note: Claude 会用 HeuDiConv 等工具转换。

say.text: 校验当前 BIDS 数据集是否合规
say.note: 会运行 bids-validator 并报告问题。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can organize neuroscience and biomedical data into BIDS-compliant layouts, query BIDS datasets via PyBIDS, validate compliance, convert DICOM to BIDS, write JSON sidecars, and create derivatives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when handling BIDS datasets, e.g. organizing MRI/EEG or other neuroscience data, querying a BIDS layout, or checking compliance.

say_en.text: Use PyBIDS to find all T1w files for every subject in this dataset.
say_en.note: Returns a list of file paths.

say_en.text: Convert this DICOM folder into BIDS format.
say_en.note: Claude will use a converter like HeuDiConv.

say_en.text: Validate the current BIDS dataset for compliance.
